The files of this folder are exported by tooling/bitperm/export.mjs from BitPerm, part of
Hawkynt/Hawkynt.github.io (https://github.com/Hawkynt/Hawkynt.github.io), commit b3a8a8e92cbca83475986391c3cac56f0b185d29:

  BitPerm/index.html  sha256 a263fee7d3562c119c301d5236337ab04fa60499df40b1665249184ff695609a
  BitPerm/README.md   sha256 82de29b0dbe780e65ad40fcd9d08fb9f7da3f06280239c57bdd18e7e261476cf

They are data read from that page: the building-block registry, the CPU presets, the solver limits,
the test cases, the mappings of the quick patterns and of the route maps the tests build, and raw
evaluation vectors of those mappings. BitPerm is licensed under the LICENSE of the repository root
at that commit (sha256 e3a994d82e644b03a792a930f574002658412f62407f5fee083f2555c5f23118):

  Version 3, 29 June 2007
